facts.business: RACE Eco Chain Ltd. is building an organised PET waste collection and recycling ecosystem in India, connecting waste generators, collectors, aggregators, and recyclers through a technology-enabled platform (RACE Eco App) and its 51% subsidiary Ganesha Recycling Chain Private Limited for PET washing and recycling.

segments.name: PET washing and recycling (via Ganesha Recycling Chain Private Limited, 51% stake)

capacity_or_capex.item: Capital expenditure on property, plant & equipment, including capital advances

guidance_or_targets.statement: By 2030, RACE aims to build a technology-enabled, traceable and ESG-aligned circular supply chain that connects waste generators, suppliers, collection centres, recyclers, processors, manufacturers and end markets.

auditor.name: Garg Arun & Associates, Chartered Accountants (FRN: 08180N)
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key audit matters: (1) Accuracy and completeness of disclosure of related party transactions; (2) Acquisition of Race Grassland Private Limited (incorporated 09 March 2026, no actual investment till 31 March 2026); (3) Disposal of India Polymers Private Limited during FY2025-26.

key_risks: Significant related party transactions requiring compliance with Companies Act 2013 and SEBI LODR
Integration risk from acquisition of Race Grassland Private Limited and disposal of India Polymers Private Limited
Dependence on informal waste collection channels for PET bottle feedstock
Execution risk in scaling PET collection network and recycling infrastructure
facts.related_party_note: The Company has various related party transactions which include sale, purchase of goods/services, loans taken and loans provided to related parties. Accuracy and completeness of disclosure of related party transactions identified as a key audit matter.
